One ruling file, workareas/shared/design-release-2-1/sources/ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm.md, about 706 lines (55 KB), scope the whole file. Lines 1-110 quote Sam verbatim, point by point from answers-2026-10-09-pm.md: search boxes (point 1), the prototype's JavaScript (point 3), ask-design rows (3a), live filtering and row lists (3b), commodities (2), documents (4), transporters (5), amend/cancel amendment/copy as new/delete (6), ownership of overview, check answers, declaration and confirmation (7), matching plants (7a), how plants changes are made (7b), the INS front door (8 and 8a) and the order of work (9). Lines 111-136 explain the orchestrator-versus-Sam marking, what ruling:sam-2026-10-09-templates covers instead, the four evidence files and the design-question numbering. Lines 137-706 list 60 numbered claims in eleven lettered sections: (a) search boxes, claims 1-4; (b) the JavaScript rule, 5-7; (c) ask-design rows and design questions 1-13, 8-22; (d) rows built with GOV.UK or MoJ, 23-27; (e) commodities wait on MDM, 28-33; (f) transporter management waits, 34-37; (g) documents, 38; (h) ownership of overview/review/declaration/confirmation, 39-42; (i) plants changes in the same increment, 43-51; (j) the INS dashboard and the animals dashboard theme, 52-59; (k) ready against blocked, 60. Most claims are the orchestrator's application of Sam's principles and name backlog rows (inc-NNN), requirements (req-NNN) and conflicts (c-NNN). Nothing is left out of scope. Because the file is long and dense with row-by-row calls, it is cut into three parts on its lettered sections; every part reads the verbatim quote in full, because each listed claim is checked against it.

Extracted in 3 parts:
Part 1, Search boxes, the JavaScript rule and design questions: Part 1 of 3 read ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm.md lines 1-374 in full: the verbatim quote of Sam's answers (lines 1-110, with points 1, 3, 3a, 3b and 6 claimed here; points 2, 4, 5, 7, 7a, 7b, 8, 8a and 9 are read only as context for later parts), the preamble at lines 111-136 (orchestrator-versus-Sam marking, what ruling:sam-2026-10-09-templates covers instead, the four evidence files, the design-question numbering), and sections (a) to (d) at lines 137-374: (a) search boxes, listed claims 1-4; (b) the JavaScript rule, 5-7; (c) ask-design rows and design questions 1-13, 8-22; (d) rows built with GOV.UK or MoJ or kept as today, 23-27. Claims follow the file's order: preamble first, then Sam's quoted decisions, then each listed claim split into one fact per claim. Listed claims marked 'Sam (point N)' are verbatim where the quote says them in so many words; claims marked as the orchestrator's application are recorded as inferred, with the quote taken from the ruling file's listed claim and the note naming the principle. Gaps record what the quote and claims leave open (the dropdown's content in point 1, Sam's hedged wording in 3a, the pop-up lean in point 6, and the outstanding design answers).
Part 2, Commodities, transporters, documents and page ownership: Part 2 read the whole verbatim quote and preamble (lines 1-136) and sections (e) to (h), lines 375-495: (e) Commodities wait on MDM, claims 28-33; (f) Transporter management waits on requirements, claims 34-37; (g) Documents, claim 38; (h) Who owns the overview, check answers, declaration and confirmation, claims 39-42. Sam's own words for points 2 (commodities), 4 (documents), 5 (transporters) and 7 (overview ownership) are claimed from the quote; the listed claims are each checked against the quote and marked verbatim where they are Sam's ruling and inferred where the file says they are the orchestrator's application of his principle. Point 7a's ownership confirmation is claimed here; its plants-consistency half (and point 7b) is section (i), part 3's. Gaps record what the quote leaves open: MDM timing and shape, who decides transporter management, the 50 MB ticket's identity in Sam's words, and the embryos/ova default.
Part 3, Plants in the same increment, dashboards and ready against blocked: Part 3 of 3. Read the verbatim quote and preamble in full (lines 1-136), then sections (i) to (k), lines 496-706: claims 43-60. Section (i), claims 43-51, is plants changes in the same increment: Sam's rule (43), the orchestrator's mirror rules (44), row-by-row plants calls for journey-foundation, reference-lists, origin and arrival (45), consignment-parties (46), overview-and-review (47), manage-notifications (48), the 5 rows the mapping could not settle (49), the list rows inc-126 and inc-140 (50), and plants changes that need the plants backend being deferred (51). Section (j), claims 52-59, is the INS dashboard's summary information blocked (52), inc-127 going ahead (53), the new animals-dashboard theme (54), plants' list in it (55), inc-133 staying blocked and dependency changes (56), 'the overall dashboard' going to the set's own list (57), the germinal set's own list (58) and c-272 not needed (59). Section (k), claim 60, is the report grouping work as ready or blocked. Only claims 43 and 60 are Sam's own rulings; claims 44-59 are the orchestrator's application of his principles (points 7a, 7b, 7c, 8, 8a), so they are recorded as inferred and checked against the quote for points 7a, 7b, 8, 8a and 9. Gaps record what the quote leaves open there. No keeps.
